lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to write programs that choose between paths with if-else, and combine conditions with and, or and not.
If-else chooses between two paths: one when the condition is true, the other when it is false.
Put an if-else inside the else to test several ranges in order — like grade boundaries.
Test values on and around each boundary: 89, 90 and 91.
Most bugs hide at the edges.
Python uses if, elif and else for the same chain of decisions.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
